title: The Member's Discount Share on a Job Under a Circle Membership
content:
## The member's discount share on the job

Where the service a job is handled under, under Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair, applies the
Circle labour discount, a share of what remains on the charge is the member's own discount share.

1. Where the service the job is handled under applies the Circle labour discount and an included visit on
   that job has been used in the twelve months ending on the handling day, the share is the repair labour
   discount of the tier together with the member only discount of the tier.
2. Where the service the job is handled under applies the Circle labour discount and no included visit on
   that job has been used in that window, the share is the repair labour discount of the tier alone.
3. Where neither of those holds, there is no member's discount share, and the share stands at 0 percent.

## The two tier percentages, and the share each reading gives

The two percentages are taken together as one share, added to each other and applied once to the whole of
what remains rather than one after the other.

| Tier | Repair labour discount (percent) | Member only discount (percent) | Share with an included visit used | Share with none used |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Circle Free Membership | 0 | 0 | 0 percent | 0 percent |
| Circle Plus Annual | 10 | 2 | 12 percent | 10 percent |
| Circle Total Annual | 25 | 5 | 30 percent | 25 percent |
| Circle Total Household Annual | 25 | 5 | 30 percent | 25 percent |
| Circle Business Pro | 20 | 4 | 24 percent | 20 percent |
| Circle Business Elite | 40 | 7 | 47 percent | 40 percent |

## Worked share on a hypothetical remainder

On Circle Business Elite, where 500.00 remains on the charge and an included visit on the job has been used
in the window, the share of 47 percent leaves 265.00. With no included visit used in that window the share of
40 percent leaves 300.00. Where the service the job is handled under does not apply the Circle labour
discount, the whole 500.00 remains on this account.
